Sam (Events): 12 min to start. Quick logistics update: roadmap moved after Q&A to give extra time for live questions. Can we confirm recording + captions?
Ivy (Eng): Encoder test shows high GPU at 4k. Switching to 720p/30 as fallback now.
Rico (Audio): Stage handheld has intermittent hiss. Switching to lav and rebalancing levels.
Sam (Events): If mic swap runs long we'll roll a 2-min warm buffer. Need someone to pin a caption-lag note in chat.
Tess (Comms): Pinning message: 'Captions may be ~20s delayed. Recording will be posted after the event.'
ops-bot: Stream health check OK. RTMP token expires in 21m. https://internal/streams/199111
Ivy (Eng): 720p stable, no dropped frames in the last 90s. Encoder reconnect retries enabled.
Rico (Audio): Lav in, levels good, hiss gone. :thumbsup:
Marta (Product): Jules, prefer Q&A first or condensed roadmap before Q&A?
Jules (CEO): Do Q&A first, then a 10-min condensed roadmap. Follow-ups for detailed demos OK post-meeting.
Sam (Events): Backup recording plan: Tess local capture + cloud ingest. Tess will upload within 1h.
Tess (Comms): Confirmed, I'll upload raw within 45m.
Sam (Events): Final: captions link pinned, mic fixed, encoder fallback set. Warm count T-3.
